info.description: A group of sessions chosen by hand, in the order they are dragged into. Used for "you might also like" beneath a session.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Sessions
edit.description: Drag them into the order they should read in. At most ten are shown; anything after the tenth is ignored.
